name: Colorado Springs Chief's Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Meet once a month with the police chief as your high school's student voice. Learn about police units, see demos and share what teens think about local issues.
who_can_apply: High school students across Colorado Springs. The page does not list ages or a deadline.
deadline_text: Dates are not stated on the page. Use the Download Applications link on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the form on the city page. Send it as shown. Email ira.cronin@coloradosprings.gov with questions.
notes: A news story said under 18 students need a parent signature. That detail is not on the city page, so ask the contact.
